summary: Nanobiotix S.A. filed a prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for a global offering of 2,184,662 ordinary shares and 345,099 pre-funded warrants. The offering includes a U.S. component of 225,373 ADSs at $38.98 per ADS and a European component of ordinary shares and pre-funded warrants. Pre-funded warrants are exercisable at €0.03 per share for ten years. Proceeds to the company are approximately $92.7 million before expenses. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special-situation event described.
